scenes.title: The Opening Question
scenes.summary: A presenter welcomes viewers to a presidential debate and invites the first candidate to question his rival about unemployment, only to get deadpan silence.

scenes.title: Can I Request Music?
scenes.summary: The presenter moves the debate through a silent rebuttal before the second candidate asks for background music so he can flex on stage.

scenes.title: Feel the Angel
scenes.summary: Both candidates abandon politics altogether and start flexing their muscles while the bewildered presenter asks what is going on.

scenes.title: Public Safety Proposal
scenes.summary: The presenter docks time as a punishment, only for the candidates to turn the penalty into a flexing contest and a public safety proposal.
